observation: Inspected the front, top and isometric views of this round; they are byte-identical to the renders inspected before the last source change, which touched only Saturn's ring. 33.50 mm square, 6.00 tall, four-fold symmetric. The rubble reads as a dense field of faceted boulders filling the border on all four sides, the central landing pad is one clean flat disc, and the front view shows every crest trimmed dead level with the pad and with the tile rim. No missing, extra, misplaced or intersecting geometry.
